body:
Public `mori test` can now read `moriarty-tests/2` manifests and drive local Core/2 load, start and resume. It compares complete reports and preserves the existing manifest profile. Source fixtures cover two deliveries, a condition that does not advance, and a captured fee calculation.

The final audit found missing incoming-liability identities in the earlier fixtures. This candidate registers them and binds six fresh, blinded reports plus whole-program and plan preimages. The blocked inputs, expectations and original review dispositions remain preserved as invalidated historical evidence. A follow-up corrects the test-header provenance.

Validation: fresh Muse Wonder1.0 high and Opus5.5 high approve the exact source and draft updates only. All CLI builds, tests and runtime comparisons remain UNRUN. Before ready-for-review or merge, update the guide/provenance links to the current binding, resolve the historical-fixture discovery question, obtain fresh reviews for changed bytes and obtain separate execution admission. No native, circuit, financial, stagenet or roadmap acceptance is claimed.
title: Add staged Core test manifests with frozen expectations
